checked.assessment: Internal owner/OWNER RIGHTS SID storage is owner-lifetime storage. The fixed union aligns the 1024-byte TOKEN_OWNER buffer for the x64 pointer; TokenOwner is copied with CopySid before the TOKEN_QUERY handle is closed and the stack buffer expires. Required SID equality permits only SYSTEM/BA; invalid/unknown/too-small/API/copy/close failure refuses. No TokenUser fallback or privilege enabling is added.

WinCreatorOwnerRightsSid is the valid SDK enum. The 320-byte ACL buffer comfortably contains the two fixed allow SIDs and OWNER RIGHTS deny SID. Deny WD|WO is created first with zero flags, then unchanged PG_ACCESS SYSTEM/BA allows. Owner is the validated copied token owner; group remains BA and the DACL remains protected.

Readback requires the retained expected owner, BA group, valid descriptor/ACL, protected DACL and exactly three ACEs. Position zero must be explicit deny OWNER RIGHTS with only WD|WO; the last two must be unique explicit SYSTEM/BA allows with unchanged PG_ACCESS, exact ACE lengths and no inheritance flags. Seen=7 refuses missing/duplicate/additional trustee. Using ACCESS_ALLOWED_ACE layout to inspect the deny is compatible with their common header/mask/SidStart layout; no object ACE is accepted.

pg_security failure follows the existing SecureZeroMemory/HeapFree PG_Create path before exposing a live owner or arming WFP. The added fields alter only private PG_OWNER allocation; exported PG_INFO remains 196 bytes/ABI1, and PG_ACCESS is unchanged.

nonblocking_precision.detail: Readback enforces deny first and the exact two unique allow trustees; the SYSTEM/BA allows may exchange relative positions. Because both allow masks and flags are identical, this is equivalent access policy, not a widening of permissions. Do not describe it as enforcing one byte-for-byte allow ordering.

This code deliberately reads the current process primary TokenOwner. The current reviewed controller does not introduce thread impersonation. This is not proof of an arbitrary impersonating-caller contract; an incompatible effective caller would have to fail closed at WFP assignment/readback. No general caller/impersonation support is qualified.

limitations: The correction has not been compiled, NULL-ABI tested, armed or read back on Windows in this review. An actual default owner outside SYSTEM/BA must still refuse.
Actual001 remains the preserved failed Win1307 run; requested owner change is a causal source correction, not retroactive repair.
